scope: Three alternating warm preparation pairs, 15% pre-run CPU limit. Includes source hashing and cache validation for reuse. Excludes project loading, browser capture, encoding and CLI startup. Same process and warm filesystem; not end-to-end export speed.

load.scope: System CPU includes renderer and other jobs; RSS is Node only, not process tree.

processes.scope: Sampled Node and descendants; summed RSS can double-count shared pages. CPU deltas exclude new/exited processes and can miss short-lived work. External CPU is other visible processes, including OS services, not a specific project. GPU/encoder services outside the tree remain external. No process names or arguments are retained.
